criterion: theta is an eigenvalue of T_G iff mu_{G-Gamma}(theta) = 0 for every 2-regular subgraph Gamma (Li-Magee-Sabri-Thomas 2025 for the maximal abelian cover, Spier 2025 for the identification with the universal cover). The empty subgraph is 2-regular.
why_rerun: the supplement decided eigenvalue membership with density-of-states and ratio-system numerics, and that step produced the withdrawn D3 and C2 claims
arithmetic: exact integers in Z[sqrt d]; no floating point anywhere in the verdicts

d3_construction.graph: two hubs, 3 copies of K_{1,3}, every leaf joined to both hubs, n=14
d3_construction.verdict: sqrt3 IS an eigenvalue of T_G. The retraction is confirmed exactly and the construction was not a near miss: no witness exists.

hall_41.graph: centre joined to 5 blocks; a block is K_{2,5} with a pendant leaf on one degree-5 vertex, the other joined to the centre; n=41
hall_41.structure: every cycle is a 4-cycle inside a block; any two share the size-2 part, so at most one cycle per block
hall_41.cut_formula: mu_{H_s} = x mu_B^s - s mu_{B-v} mu_B^(s-1), validated against brute force at p=1 (n=9) and p=2 (n=17)
hall_41.witness: a single 4-cycle in one block: mu_{G-Gamma}(sqrt5) = 1220703125 sqrt5
hall_41.verdict: sqrt5 is NOT an eigenvalue of T_G. Hall's counterexample confirmed by exact polynomial certificate, no gap estimate.
